comments.author: @doolz3561
comments.text:
AVOID THE FIRST PLACE - HONG FATT BBQ AT ALL COSTS!!!

I haven't been to Chinatown in a very long time and I was craving some BBQ Pork Ribs. Walked by and decided to give it a try and get it take out, The menu said $13, I was charged $19 and they said it's the tax (in my mind I know the math was wrong but I looked at it as a tip towards small business owner)

The chef at the window took down ribs that were under the heat lamp, Cut it and boxed it. I paid and left. went around the corner behind the place to eat and it was very cold. I returned and the lady put it in the microwave (I am not picky so I didn't really care) left and started to eat.

The meat taste was masked by the sauce but then there was a gamey, almost rotten aftertaste. at the halfway point I decided to toss the rest and hoped for the best.

I decided to walk by again and just have a look at the meat hanging in the window and there were so many flies on the meat. I was disgusted and sure enough a few hours later I've been on the toilet ever since with extreme stomach pains and explosive diarrhea. I haven't ate anything that day except for that rotten fly laden meat.

Day 3 and I am still on the toilet writing this as a warning to all to avoid this dirty, unfriendly, unsanitary place at all costs. It should be shut down by the health department.

I lost $20 to them and had to take off 3 days of work because of them. Shame on you Hong Fatt.
